# Config, environments, tenants, devices
- Non-secret params: `config/environments/<env>.json`, validated by `src/config/env.schema.ts`. Tenants live under `tenants` with optional deep-merged `overrides`.
- Secrets are referenced by NAME (`"passwordSecret": "DB_PASSWORD"`), resolved from env vars: `<ENV>_<TENANT>_<NAME>` → `<ENV>_<NAME>` → `<NAME>`. Never put secret values in JSON, code or docs.
- `readOnly: true` (prod) blocks non-GET API calls and non-SELECT SQL and excludes `@mutating` tests. Never weaken it.
- Devices: add to a group in `config/devices.ts`; select with `DEVICES=`. API/DB tests run in the browser-less `api` project.
- After changing config: `npm run health` (environment) and `npm run test:unit` (schema check of every env file).
